Genoa’s Jewish Cemetery

Cemetery · Genoa, Italy

Currently there are two Jewish sections in the cemetery: the oldest is accessed from the main entrance that has a marble portal listing of the names of the Genoese Jews deported to death camps. Inside, simple graves lie alongside more elaborate ones, influenced by the style of non-Jewish funeral monuments. Self-guided tours Visiting hours: Daily 7.30 am – 5.00 pm December 25 and Easter: 7.30 am – 1.00 pm Closed: Saturdays and Jewish holidays, January 1st and 6th, Easter Monday, June 24, August 15, December 26.
